architectural_fit_summary: Candidate for Private (VPC) deployment in EU region. Proposed topology: private data plane VPC per tenant with private API endpoints via AWS PrivateLink (or equivalent), private control plane in customer-managed VPC peered to Redwood control plane via encrypted tunnel. Inbound: no public ingress to model hosts; all traffic originates from customer app through PrivateLink/NAT gateway to Redwood ingress. Outbound: restrict egress to customer-approved telemetry endpoints; support for S3 VPC endpoints and restricted ECR access. KMS: BYOK support required — customer-managed CMKs with envelope encryption; HSM-backed recommended. Audit logging: forward inference and admin audit logs to customer's SIEM (syslog/S3 push) with configurable retention. Region: EU-WEST primary, DR in EU-CENTRAL. Requires explicit contract amendment for EU data residency.
